description: 경기도_음식물 폐기물 처리시설 현황 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 내 음식물 폐기물 처리시설의 시군별 현황을 제공하며, 처리시설의 명칭, 소재지 주소(도로명 및 지번), 우편번호, 재활용 방법, 위치 좌표(WGS84 위도 및 경도. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
